items.title: Steve Allen interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, February 15, 1999
items.q: currently manages Meadowlane Enterprises with his wife, Jayne Meadows.

ctx.x: Steve Allen was born in New York City on December 16, 1921. He traveled extensively with his parents who worked the vaudeville circuit, and played piano from an early age. His career has encompassed every aspect of show business, from radio and television, to movies and live performances. He is a prolific song writer, lyricist and author and currently manages Meadowlane Enterprises with his wife, Jayne Meadows. Mr. Allen still finds time for concert appearances and jazz recordings.
